typography.primary_font_usage: Headings, titles, quotes, traditional AYUSH elements (Do NOT use Inter)
typography.secondary_font_usage: Body text, UI elements, data, buttons, tabs

background.description: Warm Sand - main app background, calming, natural, matte.

surface.description: Pure white for main cards, Pale Sage for secondary containers and AI bubbles.

text.description: Charcoal/Dark Olive for primary readability, muted olive for secondary. No pure black.

brand.description: Deep Forest Green (Ayurveda/Nature) and Terracotta (Spices/Action). No purple gradients or teal.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2DDD3 on cards instead of heavy shadows to maintain a tactile, clinical yet organic feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle ambient shadows only on floating elements (e.g., bottom tab bar, primary CTA).
visual_enhancers.corner_radius: rounded-2xl (16px) for major cards, rounded-full for buttons and badges.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use solid warm backgrounds with crisp borders. Avoid muddy glassmorphism.

grids_and_layouts.home_dashboard: Bento Grid style. A mix of full-width cards (Daily Tip) and 2-column squares (Symptom Checker, Quick Consult).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use padding 16px to 24px (p-4 to p-6) inside cards, gap-4 to gap-6 between elements.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Bottom tab bar with 5 items (Home, Feed, Consult, Reminders, Profile). Floating style with subtle shadow.
grids_and_layouts.feed: Vertical scroll for wellness reels and tips. Full bleed images with text overlay and gradient protection (black/40).

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), Deep Forest Green background, Pure White text. Manrope font, bold.
buttons.secondary: Outline button with Terracotta border and text.

cards.doctor_profile: White background, image on top or left, tags for specialty (Ayurveda, Yoga), clear 'Book' CTA.
cards.challenge_badge: Circular or soft-square with icon/image and progress bar.

chatbot.user_bubble: White background, 1px Terracotta border, aligned right.
chatbot.ai_bubble: Pale Sage background, no border, aligned left. Include small 'AI Vaidhyaji' avatar.

inputs.style: Light background (#F7F5F0), 1px solid border (#E2DDD3), focused state changes border to Deep Forest Green.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Smooth mount/unmount animations. Scale down on button press (active opacity 0.8).
motion_and_interactions.feed_scroll: Snap to item for video/vertical feed.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders using Pale Sage color instead of generic grey.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Deep Forest Green and Terracotta meet WCAG AA contrast against Warm Sand and White.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44 points for all interactive elements.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a testID attribute for React Native.

media_and_icons.icon_library: Phosphor Icons or Lucide Icons (React Native compatible). Thin/light weights to feel premium.
media_and_icons.image_treatment: Images should have a slight warmth/fade to match the earthy palette. Never use harsh stock photos.

onboarding_splash.description: Turmeric roots and yellow flowers flatlay, perfect for the AYUSH splash screen background.

wellness_feed_1.description: Flat lay of natural ingredients and herbs for daily health tips.

wellness_feed_2.description: Aromatic herbal tea in glass for home remedies content.

doctor_avatar_1.description: Confident female doctor in a clinic setting.

community_challenge.description: Hand in Gyan Mudra (Yoga/Meditation) for wellness challenges.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React Native (Expo) syntax (.js) with standard StyleSheet or styled-components. Do not output .tsx files.
For typography, use expo-font to load 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope'.
Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do NOT use purple gradients, generic blue, or neon colors. Stick strictly to the Organic & Earthy palette.
For the bottom tab navigation, build a custom component that floats slightly above the bottom edge for a modern feel.
Implement the home dashboard using a Bento-style grid layout using React Native Views and Flexbox.
Ensure all buttons and touchable areas use TouchableOpacity or Pressable with clear visual feedback.
In the Chatbot UI, clearly differentiate user and AI messages using the specified color bubbles.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers that have content under them.
Apply testID attributes to all actionable components.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive mobile UIs that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements (borders, subtle background color shifts).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Always use the provided Image URLs. Do not use generic placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
